rev.t: If you're looking for an indulgent vegan bakery to satisfy your colossal sweet tooth in a jiffy, Pibbles is possibly the perfect spot for you. They mean it when they say they're your local sugar dealer! …

i had visited pibbles for the first time a couple months ago. my phone ran out of charge that day, and the sweetest Gouri offered me an ice cream on them that day! and, she made me taste all the 7 flavours of ice-cream that day! 🌈 …
Enjoyed my chocolate strawberry ice cream with cherry compote. I especially loved the big chunks of real strawberry in the ice cream. …
